I wrote the LRU cache in `main.wj`. I ran only Example 1, and its output matched the expected output. I did not run Example 2, any other inputs, or `wj check`.

The cache keeps two parallel lists, keys and values, ordered from most to least recently used. A `put` or successful `get` moves the key to the front. An eviction removes the last entry.
